research.question: Is the recent typical Air Force first-summary UAV total about 120-150 (median near 130), or mostly at or above 130 (22 of the last 30 nights)?
research.finding: Round one spanned 19 points (outsider 0.55). The 30-night series holds: nights to 10-14 Nov 162, 163, 123, 117, 96; to 15-22 Nov 132, 158, 306, 141, 98, 404, 148, 186; to 23 Nov 153; 22 of 30 at or above 130, median about 155. The '~80 on 13 Nov' figure the outsider used was the number shot down (80 of 117). No announced lull, weather factor or mass-strike warning for 23-24 Nov. All five reran with this union of facts; round-one numbers are kept in each agent's rounds.

sources.title: Ukrinform: Air defense downs 80 of 117 Russian drones (13 Nov)

disagreement.note: Round one spanned 0.55-0.74: the outsider, without the dossier, had read a shot-down count (80) as a night's total. Given the union of facts all five reran once (0.72-0.74). No forecaster relied on a market; none exists.

red_team.case_for_morning: A +10-point jump on one ordinary night is too much: 153 is about the median and moves the 30-night share only from 21/30 to 22/30. The claim's night is the fourth after the 20 Nov 404-drone strike, and only 4 of 6 such nights reached 130. Lull clusters (28-30 Oct, 12-14 Nov) and near-misses (123, 126, 128) remain; heavy daytime jet-drone waves on 23 Nov may come at the expense of the night count.
red_team.case_for_larger: The last 9 nights went 8/9 and the last 14 went 10/14; the Air Force spokesman speaks of up to 200 drones a night; no pause, talks have no date; retaliation for the Crimean Bridge strikes is pending and 7 of 30 nights were mass strikes far above 130. A persistent high regime could justify 75-78%.
red_team.verdict: The revision is right: 73% equals the confirmed 30-night rate (22/30), so most of the change corrects a morning figure pulled down by one forecaster's misread count rather than overreacting to 153. The fourth-night 4/6 and the 8/9 streak are small samples pulling opposite ways. No unweighed fact; nothing sent back.
